test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A can complete a work in 14 hours, while B can do the same work in 21 hours. A started working alone. After how many hours should B join A so that the total work is completed in 10 hours?
solution:
**Given:**

A can do the work in 14 hours

B can do the work in 21 hours

Total time = 10 hours

**Formula used:**

Work = LCM of individual times

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

**Calculations:**

LCM of 14 and 21 = 42

⇒ Total work = 42 units
